   132	    }
   133	
   134	    return trimmedValue;
   135	}
   136	
   137	/**
   138	 * Reads the exact branch GitHub returned, `null` when the value is not a branch name
   139	 */
   140	export function extractGithubBranchName(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
   141	    return extractGithubBranchValue(value, GITHUB_BRANCH_NAME_PATTERN);
   142	}
   143	
   144	/**
   145	 * Reads a branch pattern an administrator wrote. `*` stands for any part of the branch name, including slashes.
   146	 */
   147	export function extractGithubBranchPattern(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
   148	    return extractGithubBranchValue(value, GITHUB_BRANCH_SELECTION_PATTERN);

   150	
   151	/**
   152	 * Reads the branch selection stored for a workshop, leaving an invalid database value at the safe default branch
   153	 * rather than constructing a URL from it.
   154	 */
   155	export function extractGithubBranchSelection(
   156	    value: string | readonly string[] | null | undefined,
   157	): GithubBranchSelection {
   158	    if (typeof value !== 'string' && value !== null && value !== undefined) {
   159	        if (value.length === 0) {
   160	            // An empty array was the stored all-branches marker before branch patterns existed.
   161	            return GITHUB_ALL_BRANCHES_PATTERN;
   162	        }
   163	
   164	        const branchPatterns = value.map((branch) => extractGithubBranchPattern(branch));
   165	        if (branchPatterns.some((branchPattern) => branchPattern === null) || new Set(branchPatterns).size !== branchPatterns.length) {
   166	            return null;
   167	        }
   168	
   169	        const validBranchPatterns = branchPatterns.filter(
   170	            (branchPattern): branchPattern is string => branchPattern !== null,
   171	        );
   172	        return validBranchPatterns.length === 1 ? validBranchPatterns[0] : validBranchPatterns;
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    return extractGithubBranchPattern(value);
   176	}
   177	
   178	/** Turns one branch selection into the database array representation. */
   179	export function serializeGithubBranchSelection(selection: GithubBranchSelection): readonly string[] | null {
   180	    if (selection === null) {
   181	        return null;
   182	    }
   183	
   184	    if (typeof selection === 'string') {
   185	        return [selection];
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    // An empty array is accepted only for rows written before branch patterns. New writes keep the visible `*` value.
   189	    return selection.length === 0 ? [GITHUB_ALL_BRANCHES_PATTERN] : selection;
   190	}
   191	
   192	/**
   193	 * Gives the patterns a selection names. The empty legacy array is normalized to the visible all-branches pattern.
   194	 */
   195	export function getGithubBranchSelectionPatterns(selection: GithubBranchSelection): readonly string[] {
   196	    if (selection === null) {

   198	    }
   199	
   200	    if (typeof selection === 'string') {

   202	    }
   203	
   204	    return selection.length === 0 ? [GITHUB_ALL_BRANCHES_PATTERN] : selection;
   205	}
   206	
   207	export function isGithubAllBranchesSelection(selection: GithubBranchSelection): boolean {
   208	    return getGithubBranchSelectionPatterns(selection).includes(GITHUB_ALL_BRANCHES_PATTERN);
   209	}
   210	
   211	export function isGithubBranchPattern(branchPattern: string): boolean {
   212	    return branchPattern.includes(GITHUB_BRANCH_WILDCARD_CHARACTER);
   213	}
   214	
   215	/** Whether matching this selection needs GitHub's list of branches rather than one literal branch address. */

   219	
   220	export function isGithubMultipleBranchesSelection(selection: GithubBranchSelection): boolean {

   227	function escapeRegularExpression(value: string): string {

   230	
   231	/**
   232	 * Tells whether one actual GitHub branch is selected by a pattern. Wildcards stand for any number of characters,

   235	export function doesGithubBranchNameMatchPattern(branchName: string, branchPattern: string): boolean {

   242	
   243	/** Tells whether one actual GitHub branch is included by the whole workshop selection. */
   244	export function doesGithubBranchNameMatchSelection(branchName: string, selection: GithubBranchSelection): boolean {

   261	/**
